problem: The SPARQL branch is inverted for SHACL conformance: it selects non-applicable cases as violations, and also selects applicable category A/B ships constructed on or after 2017-01-01. Consequently, the outer sh:or rejects non-applicable cases with missing applicability data and rejects applicable cases even when the loading-condition requirements are satisfied.
required_change: Make the SPARQL constraint select only cases that establish applicability, so the branch conforms when the category/date combination is outside category A or B on or after the threshold, while preserving xsd:date validation for every present constructionDate value.
regression_guard: Preserve conditional applicability: the per-loading-condition rule must apply only to category A or B ships constructed on or after 2017-01-01.

problem: The residual-stability-factor alternative is allowed regardless of alternativeInstrumentApplicable. A loading condition with alternativeInstrumentApplicable=true and residualStabilityFactorSI=1 can therefore pass without alternativeInstrumentResidualStabilityStatus=true, although the declared formula requires the permitted alternative-instrument outcome when the alternative applies.
required_change: Guard the residualStabilityFactorSI=1 branch with alternativeInstrumentApplicable=false, leaving the alternative branch as alternativeInstrumentApplicable=true together with alternativeInstrumentResidualStabilityStatus=true.
regression_guard: Preserve the per-loading-condition factor-or-alternative-outcome check and require the alternative outcome whenever the alternative instrument applies.
